import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
import lightgbm as lgb
import os
import warnings
import time

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Define target columns
targets = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]
X_train_text = train_df["comment_text"]
X_test_text = test_df["comment_text"]

# Check class distribution per target
print("Class distribution per target:")
for col in targets:
    print(f"{col}: {train_df[col].value_counts().to_dict()}")

# TF-IDF Vectorization
print("Vectorizing text...")
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=10000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    strip_accents="unicode",
    max_df=0.95,
    min_df=5,
)
X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_text)
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_test_text)

print(f"Training matrix shape: {X_train_vec.shape}, Test: {X_test_vec.shape}")

# Train models with early stopping
models = []
auc_scores = []
validation_metrics = []

for i, col in enumerate(targets):
    print(f"\nTraining model for {col}...")
    start_time = time.time()

    # Split each target independently with stratification
    X_train, X_val, y_train_split, y_val = train_test_split(
        X_train_vec,
        train_df[col],
        test_size=0.2,
        random_state=42,
        stratify=train_df[col],
        shuffle=True,
    )

    # Fixed: Use .shape[0] instead of len() for sparse matrices
    print(f"Train: {X_train.shape[0]}, Val: {X_val.shape[0]}")

    model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
        n_estimators=300,
        max_depth=4,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        verbose=-1,
        random_state=42,
        force_col_wise=True,
    )

    # Fixed: Use callbacks parameter for early stopping instead of early_stopping_rounds
    early_stop = lgb.early_stopping(
        stopping_rounds=50, first_metric_only=True, verbose=False
    )

    model.fit(
        X_train,
        y_train_split,
        eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)],
        eval_metric="auc",
        callbacks=[early_stop],
    )

    # Calculate validation AUC
    pred_proba = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, pred_proba)
    auc_scores.append(auc)
    validation_metrics.append((col, auc))

    models.append(model)

    elapsed = time.time() - start_time
    print(f"{col} AUC: {auc:.6f}, Time: {elapsed:.1f}s")

print(f"\nMean Column-wise ROC AUC on Hold-out Validation: {np.mean(auc_scores):.6f}")

# Generate submission
print("\nGenerating submission...")
final_probs = np.column_stack([m.predict_proba(X_test_vec)[:, 1] for m in models])
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {"id": test_df["id"], **{col: final_probs[:, i] for i, col in enumerate(targets)}}
)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

# Verification
print("\nSubmission verification:")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")
print(f"Submission columns: {list(submission_df.columns)}")
print("\nFirst 5 rows of submission:")
print(submission_df.head())
print(f"\nFinal validation metric: {np.mean(auc_scores):.6f}")
